content.text: : a cog state of loss of awareness of self & situation w/ an inability to response to stimuli
: rapid onset, self-limited LOC w/ complete recovery
: prodromal Sx of syncope (ex, lightheadedness, N/V, diaphoresis, blurry vision)
: transient, self-limited LOC caused by transient, self-terminating, inadeq nutrient flow to the brain
: neural reflexes inappropriately modify HR & BP
» emotional stress (ex, fear/pain, sight of blood)
» orthostatic stress (ex, prolonged standing, USU in a warm environment)
: occurs w/ P on carotid sinus d/t carotid sinus hypersensitivity (CSH)
» ⊕ = HR (ventricular) pause ≥3s &/or SBP ⇣ ≥50mmHg when P applied
: SBP ⇣ ≥20mmHg or DBP ⇣ ≥10mmHg w/ upright posture
: antidepressants (ex, TCAs, phenothiazine APs), antiHTN agents (ex, β/⍺ blockers,
hydralazine, ACEI), vasodilators (ex, CCBs, nitrates), opiates, bromocriptine
: inadeq fluid intake, excessive loss (ex, sweating, hemorrhage), vomiting/diarrhea
: pure autonomic failure, multi system atrophy, Parkinson
: diabetes, amyloidosis, spinal cord injuries, autoimmune neuropathy (Guillain-Barré)
: tachyarrhythmias (ex, VTACH, SVT), bradyarrhythmias (ex, AV block, prolonged sinus pause)
: severe AS, HCM, ♡ tamponade, atrial myxoma
: PE, acute MI/ischemia, severe pulm HTN, aortic dissection
: detailed H&P, EKG, risk assessment, ECHO if struct Hdz sus

▪︎second degree, Mobitz II						▪︎pre-excited QRS complexes suggesting WPW
